eyebrow: Lesson 11 · B1 · Good Manners in Public · 20 câu
heading: Clean People, Clean Places
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Good Manners in Public – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 10–11, 14–15.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Good Manners in Public (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Being polite in public includes looking after yourself. Wear clean clothes on a clean body, have a bath or shower as often as you need to, and don't forget the dirt under your {fingernails|fingernails}.

paras.label: B
paras.text: Before you leave the house, take a quick look in the mirror. Is there a pizza {stain|stain} on your jumper? Do your clothes smell like the school {changing room|changing room}? People standing or sitting near you on a bus don't want to smell your {sweaty|sweaty} socks. {Fair or not|fair or not}, if you wear messy clothes, people may think you are a messy person.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Clean places matter as much as clean people. Picnics in the park are great fun, but don't leave napkins and sweet {wrappers|wrappers} lying on the grass. Nobody enjoys seeing {litter|litter}. It only takes a minute to find a bin.

paras.label: D
paras.text: When you keep parks and streets clean, you make them pleasant for everyone, and even small animals will be {grateful|grateful}. In short, help keep public spaces tidy by not being a {litterbug|litterbug}.

paras.label: E
paras.text: Taking care of yourself and your surroundings is a way of showing respect. It tells others that you care about them, and about the world we all share.

parts.title: Part 1 · Matching headings
parts.instr: Chọn tiêu đề phù hợp nhất cho mỗi đoạn. Có 2 tiêu đề thừa.
options: A final check before going out

items.label: Paragraph A
items.why: Đoạn A: tắm rửa, quần áo sạch, móng tay.

items.label: Paragraph B
items.why: Đoạn B: soi gương kiểm tra trước khi ra ngoài.

items.label: Paragraph C
items.why: Đoạn C: đi dã ngoại không để lại rác.

items.label: Paragraph D
items.why: Đoạn D: nơi sạch sẽ tốt cho mọi người, cả động vật.

items.label: Paragraph E
items.why: Đoạn E: chăm sóc bản thân và môi trường là tôn trọng người khác.

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: What does the writer suggest doing before you leave the house?
options: Take a quick look in the mirror.
questions.why: *Before you leave the house, take a quick look in the mirror.*

questions.q: The writer says people may judge you by your clothes.
questions.why: Đúng. *people may think you are a messy person.*

questions.q: *Do your clothes smell like the school changing room?* What kind of smell does the writer mean?
questions.why: Phòng thay đồ thể thao → mùi mồ hôi.

questions.q: According to paragraph C, how long does it take to find a bin?
questions.why: *It only takes a minute to find a bin.*

questions.q: The writer says only people benefit when parks are kept clean.
questions.why: Sai. *even small animals will be grateful.*

questions.q: What links the first half (A–B) and second half (C–D) of the text?
options: Caring for yourself and for places both show respect for others.
Both halves describe a trip to the park.
Both halves explain how to wash clothes.
questions.why: Đoạn E tổng kết: cả hai đều là cách *showing respect*.

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: Which paragraph does this picture match?
questions.why: Đoạn B: *take a quick look in the mirror.*
questions.alt: A girl looking at herself in a mirror and touching her face

questions.q: Who in the picture might be "grateful", as paragraph D says?
questions.why: *even small animals will be grateful* – con sóc trong tranh.
questions.alt: A girl putting rubbish into a bin while a squirrel watches

questions.q: Which word describes what the girl is NOT?
questions.why: Cô bé bỏ rác đúng chỗ → không phải **litterbug**.
questions.alt: A girl putting rubbish into a bin while a squirrel watches

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: Our class went on a picnic by the lake last Friday. [1] When we were ready to leave, our teacher pointed at the grass. [2] So we spent ten minutes picking everything up. [3]
options: We ate sandwiches, played football and had a wonderful time.
It was covered in wrappers, cans and paper napkins.
Afterwards, the place looked as clean as when we arrived.
We left everything there because the cleaners would come later.
She told us the lake was too cold for swimming.

items.why: Mô tả buổi dã ngoại vui vẻ.
Cô chỉ vào bãi cỏ → bãi cỏ đầy rác.
Sau khi nhặt rác → nơi đó sạch như lúc đến.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *Is there a pizza stain on your jumper?* (B). A **stain** is…
options: a dirty mark that is hard to remove

questions.q: *…by not being a litterbug* (D). A **litterbug** is someone who…
*…even small animals will be grateful* (D). **Grateful** means…
